title: Staff meetings on the chat server: schedule, edit with version checks, cancel, list a week, join by id
spec: docs/MEETINGS.md, slice T370a. FEATURE_MEETINGS (16384) negotiates requests 44 MeetingSave (meeting 0 schedules; otherwise an edit at a version), 45 MeetingCancel, 46 MeetingList (a UTC window of at most 8 days) and 47 MeetingJoin, the meetings follow frame 143 (crewcraft_proto::meeting) and the MeetingLine push 85; a client without the bit is refused the requests (E_NOT_ALLOWED) and gets Other for the lines. Meetings are journal records under one tag (40) with a kind byte, replayed by meetings::replay. Every meeting is staff and no request changes its audience. Only room members see, list or join a meeting; anything about a meeting in a room the person is not in is E_NO_SUCH_MEETING (14). Scheduling, editing and cancelling need a member who may start a call; editing and cancelling also need the owner or a room admin or owner (E_NOT_ALLOWED). A stale version is E_CONFLICT (13) and changes nothing; an edit equal to the saved fields after trimming succeeds at the same version with no record and no system line; a meeting with any call, open or ended, or cancelled, cannot be edited or cancelled (E_NOT_ALLOWED). Bad titles, agendas, durations, starts, windows and meetings that would end in the past are E_BAD_TEXT. MeetingJoin joins the room's open call or starts one through call_start (call records and media credentials unchanged) and links the call to the meeting; a cancelled meeting cannot be joined. The server posts MeetingLine system lines for scheduled, edited and cancelled, built from the record with the start in UTC through chrono; they never count as unread. client-core decodes the frame (ClientEvent::Meetings) and the line (ClientEvent::MeetingLine after its Pushed) and has calendar::work_week. The network server advertises FEATURE_MEETINGS. No desktop UI.
